8-3; Foreign Affairs                                                                 4-8-43

Result of Investigations re-"Central Trust and
Trading Co.", Shanghai--M.M.Lootsky, Proprietor-

As a resultof enquiries by theundersigned, the following in-
formation regarding the above firm has been obtained:-

Name of Firm:- "Central Trading & Trust Co., of Shanghai".

Proprietor:- Moisey Naumov Lootsky, 38, U.S.S.R. Citizen--
Passport No. 20/4102-- issued January 27, 1927 in
Tientsin--- Arrived in Shanghai from Tientsin December
1938.---- Member of Soviet Club and Soviet Trade Assn.

Founded:- Registered with Soviet Trade Assn. June 23rd., 1943
Application for Registration with S.M.C. on July 26th,
1943.

Kind of business:- Import, Export and General businesses;( Intending
to import some refrigerators from Tientsin if per-
mission isgranted.--);-also intention to deal in
furs during the winter months-- as will also under-
take to finance individuals or firms in the buying
of cargoes which are not restricted andat official
prices.

Capital:- $300,000

Bankers:- Moscow Narodny Bank,--9, Ave. Ed. VII.

Goods in hand:- None at present but have advanced loans to clients
to buy 80 tins of oil which is stored at present in
the godown of the Commercial Express Co.;-- valued ab-
out $100,000--also some 1,000 yardsof cotton stored
in the International Forwarding Co., which was
bought on behalf of aGerman Refugee named I.Morowitz.

Owner of premises:- Office space of one room without telephone
rented from Russian Jew Larry Gray(now Chinese Citizen
for $500 monthly.--

Office Staff:- Not yet engaged but will consist of 1 Secretary,

（批：要租在懷作製資料）

8-3；外事                                                                 1943年8月4日

关于上海“中央信托贸易公司”（Central Trust and Trading Co.）及其业主 M.M. Lootsky 的调查结果——

经具名调查人查询，获得有关上述商号的如下信息：

商号名称：“上海中央贸易信托公司”（Central Trading & Trust Co., of Shanghai）。

业主：Moisey Naumov Lootsky，38岁，苏联公民——护照号码 20/4102——1927年1月27日于天津签发——1938年12月从天津抵达上海。——苏维埃俱乐部及苏联贸易协会成员。

成立情况：1943年6月23日向苏联贸易协会注册。1943年7月26日向工部局（S.M.C.）提交注册申请。

业务性质：进出口及一般商业；（如获批准，拟从天津进口若干冰箱。）；另有意在冬季月份经营皮草生意——并将为个人或商号购买非受限且按官方定价的货物提供融资。

资本：30万美元

往来银行：莫斯科国民银行（Moscow Narodny Bank），爱多亚路（Ave. Ed. VII）9号。

现有货物：目前无存货，但已向客户发放垫款，用于购买80桶油，现存储于商业快递公司（Commercial Express Co.）的仓库中；——估值约10万美元——另有约1,000码棉布存储于国际转运公司（International Forwarding Co.），系代一名名为 I. Morowitz 的德国难民购买。

房产所有者：一间无电话的办公室，向俄籍犹太人 Larry Gray（现为中华民国公民）租用，月租金500元。

办公室职员：尚未聘用，拟设秘书1名，

（批：要租在懷作製資料）
